snippet.description:
Euler Lagrange Differential Equation Derivation & Proof | Calculus of Variations complete lecture for B.Sc, M.Sc & CSIR NET Mathematics. Master fundamental lemma and Beltrami identity step by step.

Is video lecture mein hum Calculus of Variations ke core concepts ko detail mein step-by-step cover kar rahe hain:

📌 Topics Covered in this Lecture:
1. Fundamental Lemma of Calculus of Variations (Statement & Proof by Contradiction)
2. Derivation of Euler-Lagrange Differential Equation (Necessary condition for an Extremal)
3. Application of Leibniz Rule of differentiation under integral sign & Integration by Parts
4. Alternative Forms of Euler-Lagrange Equation (Beltrami Identity / Second Form)
5. Explicit Second-Order Form of Euler-Lagrange Equation

Agar aap B.Sc Mathematics, M.Sc Maths, GATE, ya CSIR NET ki preparation kar rahe hain, toh yeh lecture aapke concept building aur exam derivations ke liye essential hai.

Timestamps:
00:00 - Introduction & Recap of Functionals
03:40 - Fundamental Lemma of Calculus of Variations (Statement)
06:18 - Fundamental Lemma (Proof by Contradiction)
19:45 - Euler-Lagrange Differential Equation (Statement & Setup)
22:00 - Euler-Lagrange Equation Derivation (Perturbation Method)
29:35 - Leibniz Rule of Differentiation Under the Integral Sign
35:45 - Integration by Parts & Boundary Conditions
39:20 - Applying Fundamental Lemma to Euler-Lagrange Equation
44:05 - Second Alternative Form (Beltrami Identity)
50:45 - Explicit Second-Order Differential Form
55:20 - Summary, Key Takeaways & Upcoming Topics
